description: Current avalanche danger bulletin for a resort's forecast zone (US, Canada, Switzerland in v1), relayed from the official warning service with the issuer + link. Returns 'no bulletin' when there's no forecast service for the area or it's off-season. NOT a substitute for the official bulletin or avalanche training.

resort.description: Same as `slug`: the resort slug or name. Pass either one.

slug.description: Resort slug or name, e.g. "portillo" or "Portillo". Required unless `resort` is given.

name: get_avalanche

markdown.description: Human-readable markdown summary of the tool result (may be omitted when structuredContent carries a typed payload; content[0].text always has the prose).

title: Avalanche bulletin
